name: Triaging Issues
title_zh: 把 GitHub 工单变成可执行的工厂流水线输入
tagline_zh: 新工单进来先别急着动手——查重、贴标签、判断要不要追问，一步到位。专治重复 issue 和缺复现步骤的烂摊子。
tagline_en: New issue? Don't dive in yet—dedupe, label, decide if you need more info. Built for messy repos with duplicate.
desc_en: Grounding a GitHub work item before running the factory pipeline: checking for duplicates, working with the repo's existing labels, deciding whether to ask for clarification or proceed, and asking for reproduction details well. Load whenever a work item arrives from a GitHub issue or mention, and whenever asked to triage, label, dedupe, or close issues. Not needed for work items that arrive as pla
why_zh: 它把 triage 变成一套显式规则，而不是靠感觉：先查重、再匹配现有标签、拿不准就停下来问。
why_en: Turns triage into explicit rules, not vibes: dedupe first, match existing labels, and stop to ask when uncertain—instead of.
limit_zh: 只认 GitHub issue 或 mention 进来的工单；纯文本描述或已带完整复现步骤的工单它不碰。
limit_en: Only for GitHub issues/mentions; ignores plain-text or fully-specified tickets. Output stops at 'next step'—won't code or close issues for you.
